summary: Rackspace Technology filed an 8-K disclosing a workforce realignment plan approved by its Executive Committee on June 10, 2026. The plan eliminates approximately 15% of the global workforce, targeting legacy Public Cloud delivery functions to redeploy resources toward enterprise AI. One-time charges of $14-$19 million are expected in 2026, with annualized run-rate savings of $75-$85 million. Notice was given on or about June 10; additional exits occur over six months. The company may implement further operational optimization measures. Watch actual savings relative to estimates, reinvestment pace into AI, and any future restructuring announcements.
